name: past-attendance-approval-overtime-demo
title: Seed past attendance approvals and overtime
description: Keep the two-week schedule, but create attendance, review queues, and overtime only for completed Vietnam calendar days.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: PR #1206 stops attendance at 06/07/2026 for the default 07/07/2026 as-of date. Future shifts remain scheduled without timesheets, correction reviews, off-schedule attendance, or overtime. The seed temporarily excludes future shifts only while recalculating the demo snapshot, then restores them to scheduled. Local Mongo seed and verifier remain required.
